title: Detailed drum
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Drum shell -->
  <rect x='22' y='30' width='56' height='44' rx='4' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <!-- Shell highlight -->
  <rect x='22' y='30' width='10' height='44' rx='4' fill='#e05a4a'/>
  <rect x='68' y='30' width='10' height='44' rx='4' fill='#8e2b20'/>
  <!-- Top head (drum skin) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='28' ry='10' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='29' rx='22' ry='7' fill='#fff8e8'/>
  <!-- Bottom head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='28' ry='10' fill='#d9c39a'/>
  <!-- Rim hoops -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='28' ry='10' fill='none' stroke='#f1c40f' stroke-width='4'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='28' ry='10' fill='none' stroke='#f1c40f' stroke-width='4'/>
  <!-- Tension rods -->
  <line x1='24' y1='32' x2='24' y2='72' stroke='#d4d4d4' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <line x1='37' y1='25' x2='37' y2='79' stroke='#d4d4d4' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='20' x2='50' y2='84' stroke='#d4d4d4' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <line x1='63' y1='25' x2='63' y2='79' stroke='#d4d4d4' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <line x1='76' y1='32' x2='76' y2='72' stroke='#d4d4d4' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- Lug casings -->
  <rect x='21' y='46' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#bdc3c7'/>
  <rect x='34' y='46' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#bdc3c7'/>
  <rect x='47' y='46' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#bdc3c7'/>
  <rect x='60' y='46' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#bdc3c7'/>
  <rect x='73' y='46' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#bdc3c7'/>
  <!-- Drumstick left -->
  <line x1='10' y1='12' x2='40' y2='28' stroke='#e8b04b' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='9' cy='11' r='4' fill='#f5deb3'/>
  <!-- Drumstick right -->
  <line x1='90' y1='12' x2='60' y2='28' stroke='#e8b04b' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='91' cy='11' r='4' fill='#f5deb3'/>
</svg>
